How is the market doing under President Trump? The S&P 500 generated a total return of more than 37% from the November 5, 2024, election through August 7, 2026, despite a nearly 20% decline in early 2025. Stocks recovered because consumer and business spending supported company revenue, record profit margins converted that revenue into record earnings, and investors looked beyond recurring policy and geopolitical shocks.
